Product Details: Keep your matte-finish vehicles looking clean, protected, and showroom-fresh with the Wavex Matte Finish Care Combo. This all-in-one maintenance kit includes Wavex Matte Finish Protectant Polish (350ml), Wavex Matte Car & Bike Shampoo (350ml), and a premium Wavex Microfiber 2-in-1 Wash Mitt to provide complete cleaning, protection, and care for matte-painted surfaces. The Matte Shampoo effectively removes dirt, dust, road grime, and contaminants without affecting the unique appearance of matte paint. Its gentle foaming formula cleans thoroughly while preserving the original matte texture and finish. After washing, the Matte Finish Protectant Polish helps protect the surface from environmental contaminants, UV exposure, and everyday wear while enhancing the richness of the matte finish without adding unwanted gloss or shine. The included Microfiber 2-in-1 Wash Mitt features dual-sided microfiber construction that lifts and traps dirt safely, helping reduce the risk of scratches and swirl marks during washing and detailing. It is reusable, durable, and machine washable for long-lasting performance.
